packageView.description: An indexed package. `record` is the publisher's profile verbatim; `status` and `latestVersion` are the registry's.

handle.description: The publisher's handle, when the registry can resolve one. Absent otherwise; a client should not treat its absence as the package being unowned.

status.description: `deleted` means the publisher withdrew the profile. The package stays readable and its releases stay resolvable by exact version; it is left out of search.

latestVersion.description: The highest `active` version, by semver precedence, where a prerelease ranks below the same core version. Absent when no version is active yet.

releaseView.description: An indexed release. `record` is the publisher's release verbatim; `status` is the registry's.

status.description: `active` means the registry holds the artifact bytes and will serve them. `pending` means it has indexed the release but not yet copied them, so getArtifact will not answer. `deleted` means the publisher withdrew it: left out of search, out of `latestVersion` and out of dependency resolution, but still served by exact version.
